summary: Merges SOP geometry from paths that can span multiple components, baking source component transforms into a shared SOP space.

key_params.name: xform
key_params.note: Geometry COMP that merged geometry should be transformed relative to

key_params.name: merge
key_params.note: Sequence of source SOP entries to merge

key_params.name: merge0sop
key_params.note: First SOP path or pattern to merge, including sources in other components

common_gotchas: Object Merge SOP bakes component transforms, so coordinates can differ from selecting geometry in-place inside the source COMP.
Wildcard SOP paths can merge more geometry than intended; prefer stable null/output SOP paths for planner-created systems.
The official parameter ids are xform, merge, and merge0sop; older objpath/createpath/group-style ids are not current page parameters.
key_concepts: Merges geometry from one or more SOP paths, including SOPs that live inside different components.
Source component transforms are baked so the merged SOPs become relative to each other in one geometry stream.
The Transform Object parameter can remap the merged result relative to a target Geometry COMP.
Merge sequence entries accept SOP path patterns, including wildcards, so source selection should be explicit in production networks.
